descriptionChirho: To lead or bring someone up to a higher physical location, such as up a mountain (Matt 17:1, Mark 9:2) or up into heaven (Luke 24:51).
To offer up a sacrifice to God, whether literal animal offerings or the spiritual sacrifices of praise (Heb 7:27, 13:15; 1 Pet 2:5; Jas 2:21).
To bear or carry sins upon oneself as a substitutionary act, used of Christ bearing sins in his body on the cross (Heb 9:28; 1 Pet 2:24).
